kz-msux97.p: Which novel begins by saying it was the best and the worst of times?
kz-msux97.e: Charles Dickens' novel is set in London and Paris during the French Revolution.

kz-1u3bzis.e: The novel about the Devil's visit to Moscow could first be published in 1966, 26 years after the author's death.

kz-1lhqmwp.p: Which writer hid behind the name George Eliot?
kz-1lhqmwp.e: She chose a man's name so that she would be taken seriously. Aurore Dupin did the same as George Sand.

kz-tiu45s.p: Who wrote “The Fishermen”, about the Inner Mission people of western Jutland by the Limfjord?
kz-tiu45s.e: The collective novel from 1928 has no main character – it is the community that it is about.

kz-11e0a74.p: Who wrote the poem about the stonemason “Jens Vejmand”?
kz-11e0a74.e: Carl Nielsen set it to music, and the song became so popular that it almost gained the status of a folk song.

kz-za2i02.e: The novel about the daydreamer Conrad is regarded as an early psychological breakthrough in Danish literature.

kz-p2hinu.p: Which Soviet film from 1925 is famous for the scene on the steps in Odessa?
kz-p2hinu.e: Sergei Eisenstein's pram that rolls down the steps has been quoted in countless later films.

kz-1fvzqu6.e: The 1954 film was remade in Hollywood as the western “The Magnificent Seven”.

kz-vonyis.p: With which film did Kathryn Bigelow become the first woman to win an Oscar for directing?
kz-vonyis.e: She won in 2010 – beating, among others, her ex-husband James Cameron, who was nominated for “Avatar”.

kz-yn2790.p: Which Danish film won the Palme d'Or at Cannes in 2000?
kz-yn2790.e: Lars von Trier's musical also earned Björk the prize for best actress.

kz-1nr7d0j.p: Which Danish animated documentary was Oscar-nominated in three categories in 2022?
kz-1nr7d0j.e: The film tells the story of an Afghan boy's flight to Denmark and was nominated as documentary, animated feature and international feature.

kz-1vgi21s.p: Which drama series has won the most Emmy Awards ever?
kz-1vgi21s.e: The series won 59 statuettes over eight seasons.

kz-1dw8e9c.e: Balling also directed the Olsen Gang films and “The House on Christianshavn”. Lise Nørgaard came up with the idea and wrote many of the episodes.

kz-1sei7nj.p: What is the name of Mads Skjern's brother, who also settles in Korsbæk?
kz-1sei7nj.e: Kristen Skjern runs Omegnsbanken. Daniel is Mads' son, and Ulrik is the son of bank director Varnæs.

kz-1x48fcv.p: Who composed the opera cycle “The Ring of the Nibelung”?
kz-1x48fcv.e: The four operas last about 15 hours in total and are performed every summer in Bayreuth.

kz-527kov.p: Which interval was called “the devil in music” in the Middle Ages?
kz-527kov.e: The interval of three whole tones sounds uneasy and is used often in heavy metal and in the theme from “The Simpsons”.

kz-erc5tw.p: Who in 1987 became the first woman in the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame?
kz-erc5tw.e: The queen of soul was inducted in the museum's second year.

kz-1kiizbz.p: Who composed “Elverskud” and became conductor of the Gewandhaus Orchestra in Leipzig?
kz-1kiizbz.e: Gade was his era's most famous Danish composer abroad and a close friend of Mendelssohn.

kz-bfgk0u.p: Who wrote the music for the national play “Elverhøj”?
kz-bfgk0u.e: The overture ends with the royal anthem and is known to many from the Olsen Gang's heist at the Royal Danish Theatre.

kz-1cwa1el.p: Who released the solo album “Værsgo” in 1973?
kz-1cwa1el.e: The record includes, among others, “Joanna” and “Det er i dag et vejr”.

kz-5mzynr.p: What was the name of Nintendo's 1980 handheld range with one game per unit?
kz-5mzynr.e: The directional cross, which all later consoles have inherited, was invented for the series.

kz-1vwhj4m.e: Kojima turned sneaking past the enemy into a whole genre.

kz-d6amo3.p: Which country has won the most medals at the Winter Olympics through history?
kz-d6amo3.e: A country with just over five million inhabitants has won over 400 medals – most of them in cross-country skiing and biathlon.

kz-1slj0c6.p: Which city became in 2012 the first to have hosted the Summer Olympics three times?
kz-1slj0c6.e: London hosted in 1908, 1948 and 2012. Paris reached three in 2024.

kz-1vcitcn.p: In which year did Denmark win Olympic gold in men's handball for the first time?
kz-1vcitcn.e: In Rio, Denmark beat France in the final. The gold was repeated in Paris in 2024.

kz-1qk7pom.p: Who scored the winning goal when Denmark beat England at Wembley in 1983?
kz-1qk7pom.e: The goal sent Denmark to the 1984 European Championship and marked the start of the national team's golden decade.

kz-1epy6p6.p: Who is the only player to have won the World Cup three times as a player?
kz-1epy6p6.e: The Brazilian won in 1958, 1962 and 1970. The first time he was 17.

kz-j5d15c.p: Which country won the first European Football Championship in 1960?
kz-j5d15c.e: Only four teams took part in the finals in France.

kz-145srbl.p: Who is the only goalkeeper to have won the Ballon d'Or?
kz-145srbl.e: “The Black Spider” from Dynamo Moscow won the award in 1963.

kz-nhp08r.p: Which vertebrate lives the longest – presumably over 250 years?
kz-nhp08r.e: The shark grows only one centimetre a year and only becomes sexually mature at around 150 years.

kz-1oja0wt.p: Which mammal is the only one covered in scales?
kz-1oja0wt.e: The scales are made of keratin, like fingernails. The pangolin is the world's most trafficked mammal.

kz-1haak5u.p: Which breeding bird in Denmark can fly for up to ten months without landing?
kz-1haak5u.e: It eats, sleeps and mates in the air, and lands only to brood.

kz-1mku5z8.e: Furesø is just under 38 metres deep. Arresø is the largest lake, but only a few metres deep.

kz-dpnkce.p: Who is the mother of Perseus – the woman Zeus visited as a shower of gold?
kz-dpnkce.e: Leda was visited by Zeus as a swan and Europa by Zeus as a bull.

kz-5gd1kl.p: What are the three goddesses of fate who spin the thread of human life called?
kz-5gd1kl.e: One spins the thread, another measures it, and the third cuts it off.

kz-15h9hqk.p: What are the three norns at Urd's well called?
kz-15h9hqk.e: They stand for past, present and future and determine the fate of both gods and humans.

kz-qgpk2h.p: What is the name of the rooster that wakes the Æsir at Ragnarök?
kz-qgpk2h.e: Sæhrimnir is the boar that is eaten every evening in Valhalla, and Heidrun is the goat that gives mead.

kz-bfzqh.p: What is the name of Albus Dumbledore's brother?
kz-bfzqh.e: He is the innkeeper in Hogsmeade and helps Harry in the last book.

kz-1g42uso.p: Which magic potion gives the one who drinks it good luck?
kz-1g42uso.e: Veritaserum forces a person to tell the truth, and Amortentia is a love potion.

kz-72vfe6.p: What do the elves call Gandalf?
kz-72vfe6.e: The name means the Grey Pilgrim. Curunír is Saruman, and Aiwendil is Radagast.

kz-1e233t0.p: Who was Sauron's master in the First Age?
kz-1e233t0.e: Sauron was only a lieutenant of the first dark lord, whose story is told in “The Silmarillion”.

kz-102cvny.p: Which planet does Chewbacca come from?
kz-102cvny.e: The Wookiees live in giant trees on the forest-covered planet.

kz-13bs93s.e: Lucas handed the director's chair to his old teacher. Richard Marquand directed “Return of the Jedi”.

kz-re75ur.p: Which character did Walt Disney create before Mickey Mouse – and lost the rights to?
kz-re75ur.e: The loss of Oswald in 1928 led Disney to draw a mouse on the train journey home. The Disney company bought the rabbit back in 2006.

kz-19w7wta.p: Which year did H.C. Andersen publish his first fairy tales?
kz-19w7wta.e: The first booklet contained, among others, “The Tinderbox” and “The Princess and the Pea”.

kz-dyubku.p: What is the title of H.C. Andersen's autobiography?
o: The Fairy Tale of My Life
kz-dyubku.e: The next two are novels. The autobiography begins with the words that his life is a beautiful fairy tale.

kz-5nkmye.p: Which sports brand was founded by Adi Dassler's brother?
kz-5nkmye.e: The two brothers fell out and each built a factory in the same small German town, Herzogenaurach.

kz-1apk1nx.p: Which company was originally called Tokyo Tsushin Kogyo?
kz-1apk1nx.e: The name was changed in 1958 because nobody outside Japan could pronounce it.

kz-1sjvsee.p: Which Danish company began in the attic of a manor house near Struer in 1925?
kz-1sjvsee.e: Peter Bang and Svend Olufsen built a radio that could be plugged straight into the wall socket instead of running on batteries.

kz-1vthcll.p: What is the Japanese theatre with masks and very slow movements called?
kz-1vthcll.e: Nō theatre is over 600 years old. Kabuki is the colourful and loud cousin, and bunraku is puppet theatre.

kz-31ghsh.e: The painter has put himself into the picture of the Spanish princess and her ladies-in-waiting.

kz-1ovmy3d.p: Which art movement did Piet Mondrian belong to?
kz-1ovmy3d.e: The Dutch group kept to straight lines, black, white and the three primary colours.

kz-183l7ll.e: The dark picture from 1885 was painted in Holland, before van Gogh found his strong colours in southern France.

o: The French term for raw concrete
kz-rga5zv.e: Béton brut – raw concrete – was Le Corbusier's term for facades where you can see the imprint of the formwork.

kz-1dyv20h.p: Which architect designed the house Fallingwater over a waterfall?
kz-1dyv20h.e: The house in Pennsylvania from 1937 is regarded as a major work of American architecture.

kz-2ds0qy.p: What is a sentence that contains every letter of the alphabet called?
kz-2ds0qy.e: The best-known English example is the sentence about the quick brown fox that jumps over the lazy dog.

kz-e9yarz.p: What is the study of the origin of words called?
kz-e9yarz.e: Entomology is the study of insects – a confusion that has tripped up many people.

kz-1gzjz6q.p: Which Dane took off in 1906, as one of the first in Europe, in a motor-powered aircraft?
kz-1gzjz6q.e: The aircraft hung on a line from a pole on the island of Lindholm and flew 42 metres at a height of half a metre.

kz-1ukmpf.p: Who invented the Writing Ball, the world's first mass-produced typewriter?
kz-1ukmpf.e: The Danish priest and headmaster was granted a patent in 1870. The philosopher Nietzsche wrote on one of them.

kz-m2tr9g.p: Who in 1909 became the first woman to win the Nobel Prize in Literature?
kz-m2tr9g.e: The Swede wrote, among others, “The Saga of Gösta Berling” and the children's book “The Wonderful Adventures of Nils”.

kz-5b651u.p: Which Danish doctor won the Nobel Prize in 1903 for treating skin tuberculosis with light?
kz-5b651u.e: Finsen was born in the Faroe Islands and was Denmark's first Nobel laureate.

kz-1m4k25s.e: The head is split, singed and boiled. Many consider the eye the best bite.

o: Egg, flour and breadcrumbs for coating
kz-ai6lk8.e: The vegetables are sweated as a flavour base for stocks, soups and sauces.

kz-l6ywew.p: Which of these is not one of the five basic sauces of French cuisine?
kz-l6ywew.e: The five are béchamel, velouté, espagnole, tomato sauce and hollandaise. Béarnaise is derived from hollandaise.

kz-1095urm.e: The food is vacuum-packed and cooked for a long time in water at a precise, low temperature.

kz-1u88zdp.p: What is autolyse in bread baking?
o: Flour and water rest before kneading
The dough rises in the fridge
The yeast is dissolved in sugar
The bread cools on a rack
kz-1u88zdp.e: During the rest, gluten starts to form on its own, so the dough needs less kneading.

kz-124mg26.p: Which green grape is one of the three main grapes in champagne?
kz-124mg26.e: The other two, Pinot Noir and Pinot Meunier, are black-skinned.

kz-if6cwh.p: What is the “angel's share” in a whisky cask?
o: The tax paid to the state
kz-if6cwh.e: About 2 per cent of the contents disappear through the wood each year.

kz-t700cx.p: Which Scottish island do the smoky whiskies Laphroaig, Lagavulin and Ardbeg come from?
kz-t700cx.e: The malt is dried over peat smoke, which gives the characteristic taste of tar and sea.

o: High inflation and low growth at the same time
Rising interest rates and rising growth
kz-10biupk.e: The combination hit the West after the 1973 oil crisis and is hard to fight, because the remedies for one make the other worse.

kz-1v4itbh.p: Which agreement from 1944 tied the world's currencies to the dollar and the dollar to gold?
kz-1v4itbh.e: The system collapsed in 1971, when the USA ended the dollar's link to gold.

kz-1k8cx1t.p: What does the Gini coefficient measure?
kz-1k8cx1t.e: 0 means that everyone has the same amount. 1 means that one person owns everything.

kz-1tkptbg.p: What does the Keeling Curve show?
o: The thickness of the ozone layer
The extent of the polar ice
kz-1tkptbg.e: The measurements on the Mauna Loa volcano in Hawaii have been carried out continuously since 1958.

kz-1ijf4pr.p: Which year did the Brundtland Report give the world the concept of sustainable development?
kz-1ijf4pr.e: The report defined it as development that meets the needs of the present without destroying the opportunities of future generations.

kz-lwd89o.p: Which nerve connects the brain with the heart, lungs and intestines?
kz-lwd89o.e: The name means the wandering nerve. It is the body's most important brake on pulse and stress.

kz-110jbwe.p: Which bone is the only one not connected to any other bone?
kz-110jbwe.e: The small horseshoe-shaped bone hangs in muscles and ligaments under the tongue.

kz-1j73vnf.p: What was the name of the three-wheeled Danish electric car from 1987?
kz-1j73vnf.e: The Mini-El was built in Randers to the inventor Steen V. Jensen's drawings and was called everything from a cabin scooter to a rolling vacuum cleaner.

kz-x9z77u.p: Which Greenpeace ship was sunk by French intelligence agents in 1985?
kz-x9z77u.e: The ship was in port in Auckland on its way to protest French nuclear tests. A photographer was killed.

kz-4s50ne.p: What is the name of the agreement that ended the war in Bosnia in 1995?
kz-4s50ne.e: The negotiations were held at an air base in Dayton, Ohio.

kz-gkykwr.p: What was the name of the first privately financed spacecraft to reach space with a pilot, in 2004?
kz-gkykwr.e: The craft won the Ansari X Prize of 10 million dollars by reaching over 100 kilometres altitude twice within two weeks.

kz-1geiq48.p: What was the name of the surveillance programme that Edward Snowden revealed in 2013?
kz-1geiq48.e: The programme gave the US intelligence agency NSA access to data from the major tech companies.

kz-451n17.p: What is the name of the EU's law on artificial intelligence, adopted in 2024?
kz-451n17.e: The law sorts AI systems by risk and bans, among other things, social scoring of citizens.

kz-tu8fdc.p: True or false: A penguin at Edinburgh Zoo has been knighted by the Norwegian Royal Guard.
kz-tu8fdc.e: The king penguin Sir Nils Olav is the mascot of His Majesty the King's Guard and has been promoted several times since 1972.

kz-1ei0255.p: What is the old rule of conduct called: “Do unto others as you would have them do unto you”?
o: The Law of the Golden Calf
kz-1ei0255.e: The idea appears in almost all cultures and religions. Aristotle's golden mean, by contrast, is about avoiding extremes.

o: That virtue lies between two extremes
That one should always choose the middle option
That all choices are equally good
kz-1lpdo4v.e: Courage, for example, lies between cowardice and recklessness.

kz-1dlhckg.p: What is the name of John Searle's 1980 thought experiment about a man who answers questions in a language he does not understand?
kz-1dlhckg.e: Searle used it to argue that a program can behave intelligently without understanding anything.

kz-c16cdw.p: Which thought experiment from 1935 is about a cat in a closed box?
kz-c16cdw.e: Erwin Schrödinger wanted to show how strange the rules of quantum mechanics become when applied to everyday things.

kz-24m6s5.p: What is the name of the ethics that judges an action by its consequences?
kz-24m6s5.e: Utilitarianism is the best-known version. Kant represents the opposite line of thought, deontology.

kz-1624azs.p: What does Camus say we should imagine Sisyphus to be?
kz-1624azs.e: The essay “The Myth of Sisyphus” ends by saying that the struggle towards the summit is in itself enough to fill a human heart.

kz-qfxnon.e: The book was published under the pseudonym Johannes de silentio and is about Abraham, who must sacrifice his son.

kz-1l56eso.p: Which philosopher claimed that “hell is other people”?
kz-1l56eso.e: The line comes from the play “No Exit” from 1944, in which three people are locked in together.

kz-1ju3jnw.e: Socrates never wrote anything himself. Everything we know about him comes from Plato and other students.

kz-iic7df.p: Which philosophical movement is associated with Sartre and Simone de Beauvoir?
kz-iic7df.e: The existentialists held that human beings first exist and must then themselves give life meaning.

kz-1aedd84.e: The book opens with the line that man is born free, yet everywhere he is in chains.

kz-n164q7.p: Who wrote “Leviathan” in 1651 and argued that the state is necessary to avoid a war of all against all?
kz-n164q7.e: Hobbes lived through the English Civil War and saw a strong state as the only path to peace.

kz-1s3w2v1.e: Kant argued that knowledge rests both on sensation and on the understanding's own forms. He reportedly never left Königsberg.

kz-1q8ioj1.p: Which Greek philosopher founded the school Lyceum in Athens?
kz-1q8ioj1.e: Plato founded the Academy, Epicurus the Garden and Zeno the Stoa.

kz-qv68ag.p: Who wrote the “Tractatus Logico-Philosophicus”, which ends with the words that one must be silent about what one cannot speak of?
kz-qv68ag.e: Wittgenstein believed the book had solved the problems of philosophy, and then withdrew for a time to work as a village schoolteacher.

kz-19mf8e1.p: Who wrote “The World as Will and Representation” in 1818?
kz-19mf8e1.e: Schopenhauer is called the philosopher of pessimism and hated Hegel so much that he scheduled his lectures at the same time as Hegel's. Almost nobody came.

kz-1p7t47y.p: Who created the psychological test with symmetrical inkblots?
kz-1p7t47y.e: The Swiss psychiatrist published the test in 1921 and died only a year later.

kz-orzse0.p: Which psychologist is known for the difference between a “fixed mindset” and a “growth mindset”?
kz-orzse0.e: Dweck showed that children praised for effort rather than talent dare to take on harder tasks.

kz-1ldnig8.p: Who developed the theory of human psychosocial development in eight stages?
kz-1ldnig8.e: Erikson's stages begin with trust versus mistrust in infancy and end with integrity versus despair in old age.

kz-1r06846.p: What is the tendency to explain other people's mistakes by their personality, but our own mistakes by circumstances, called?
kz-1r06846.e: The person who arrives late is irresponsible. You yourself have just been unlucky with the traffic.

kz-1pwmfmp.p: What is the thinking error called in which a random number affects our later estimates?
kz-1pwmfmp.e: In experiments, people guess a higher number if they have just seen a high one – even when the number was drawn by lottery.

kz-1d4e0vk.e: Arresø in North Zealand covers just over 40 square kilometres, but is only about three metres deep.

kz-1rxtskm.p: Which Danish island in the Wadden Sea is the largest?
kz-1rxtskm.e: Rømø is known for the widest beach in northern Europe, where you can drive a car.

kz-1xors2m.p: Which volcano in Iceland erupted in 1783 and affected the climate across the whole of Europe?
kz-1xors2m.e: The eruption spread sulphur haze across the continent, causing a cold winter, poor harvests and famine.

kz-1l9eps8.p: Which island rose out of the sea off Iceland during a volcanic eruption in 1963?
kz-1l9eps8.e: Scientists were able to follow how plants and animals colonise completely new land.

kz-sy3m4i.p: Which glacier is the largest on the European mainland?
kz-sy3m4i.e: Jostedalsbreen in Norway covers just under 500 square kilometres.

kz-uf2dob.p: True or false: Denmark's highest natural point lies less than 200 metres above sea level.
kz-uf2dob.e: Møllehøj in East Jutland is just under 171 metres. So all Danish mountains are what other countries would call hills.

kz-1odlnl1.p: Which fish spawns in the Sargasso Sea but grows up in Danish streams and lakes?
kz-1odlnl1.e: The tiny glass eels drift with the Gulf Stream for several years across the Atlantic before reaching European coasts.

kz-1d5dyrp.p: Which bird lays its eggs in the nests of other birds?
kz-1d5dyrp.e: The cuckoo chick often pushes the host bird's own eggs out of the nest.

kz-cqvweo.p: Which bird has the longest migration in the world, flying from the Arctic to the Antarctic and back?
kz-cqvweo.e: The Arctic tern flies up to 70,000 kilometres a year and experiences more sunlight than any other animal.

kz-18iaewr.p: Which fish was the basis of the wealth of the Skånemarkedet in the Middle Ages?
kz-18iaewr.e: Hanseatic merchants salted the herring in barrels and sent them to the whole of Europe.

kz-19za7hr.p: True or false: There are wild beavers living in Denmark.
kz-19za7hr.e: The beaver was wiped out around 2,000 years ago, but was reintroduced in Klosterheden in Jutland in 1999.

kz-f2uhxr.p: Which of these birds is the heaviest that breeds in Denmark?
kz-f2uhxr.e: The male can weigh over ten kilograms. The white-tailed eagle has the largest wingspan but weighs less.

kz-1xkdq6l.p: Who co-founded Wikipedia together with Larry Sanger?
kz-1xkdq6l.e: No adverts and no owners: Wikipedia is run by the non-profit Wikimedia Foundation.

kz-e4lfes.p: True or false: Wikipedia is owned by a company that earns money from advertising.
kz-e4lfes.e: Wikipedia is run by the non-profit Wikimedia Foundation and funded by donations.

kz-9bwneh.p: Which social media platform began as the site Facemash at Harvard?
kz-9bwneh.e: Mark Zuckerberg created the site in 2003 and was called to a meeting with the school's management.

kz-1ncnotw.p: What was the internet's first search engine, from 1990?
kz-1ncnotw.e: Archie indexed files on open FTP servers, so it came before the web itself.

kz-5jw8ir.p: What is the name of the Danish digital ID that replaced NemID?
kz-5jw8ir.e: MitID was introduced from 2021 and fully replaced NemID in 2023.

o: Internet that only works at night
kz-bbosno.e: The dark web is not illegal in itself. It is also used by journalists and activists in countries with censorship.

kz-668irr.e: Google bought it in 2006 for $1.65 billion, only a year after its launch.

kz-9i9xky.p: What is the name of the UN climate panel that gathers researchers' knowledge of the climate?
kz-9i9xky.e: The panel was founded in 1988 and shared the Nobel Peace Prize with Al Gore in 2007.

kz-vtxmtp.p: What is it called when a company presents itself as greener in its marketing than it really is?
kz-vtxmtp.e: The word was first used in 1986 by an environmental activist who saw hotels urging guests to reuse towels.

kz-1v2x3xe.p: What share of Denmark's electricity consumption was covered by wind power in 2023?
kz-1v2x3xe.e: Few countries in the world get such a large share of their power from the wind.

kz-19rkkfy.p: What does the abbreviation SUV stand for?
kz-19rkkfy.e: The term covers tall cars with high ground clearance, originally built for off-road driving.

kz-1ayingi.p: What was the name of the first Danish ship with a diesel engine, which sailed the seas from 1912?
kz-1ayingi.e: B&W in Copenhagen built the ship for the East Asiatic Company. The engine made the coal used by steamships unnecessary.

kz-6hu4b6.e: The shipping line that owned the vessel was called the White Star Line. The ship was built in Belfast and sailed from Southampton.

kz-gphbq3.p: In which section of the Danish Constitution is the right to express one's thoughts in print, in writing and in speech?
kz-gphbq3.e: Section 78 deals with freedom of association and section 79 with freedom of assembly. Censorship must not be reintroduced.

kz-1d6yq4d.p: Which emperor issued the Edict of Milan in 313, granting Christians religious freedom?
kz-1d6yq4d.e: Constantine had himself baptised on his deathbed. It was Theodosius who made Christianity the state religion in 380.

kz-6vo0dm.p: In which year was Charlemagne crowned emperor in Rome?
kz-6vo0dm.e: The pope crowned him on Christmas Day. It marks the beginning of the medieval empire in Western Europe.

kz-k9fcrd.p: Which peace treaty in 1814 ended the union between Denmark and Norway?
kz-k9fcrd.e: The Peace of Prague dates from 1866. The Peace of Roskilde in 1658 gave Skåne to the Swedes.

kz-1hgopl8.p: What is the capital of Bhutan?
kz-1hgopl8.e: Thimphu has no traffic lights. A police officer directs the traffic at the city's central junctions.

kz-rxzsso.p: Which is the largest landlocked country in the world?
kz-rxzsso.e: The country is over 60 times the size of Denmark.

kz-lhd831.p: What are the particles called that bind quarks together in the atomic nucleus?
kz-lhd831.e: The name comes from the English word 'glue'. The force they carry is called the strong nuclear force.

kz-y2ktln.p: What is the minimum speed a rocket must reach to escape Earth's gravity?
kz-y2ktln.e: 7.9 km/s is the speed needed to stay in orbit close to Earth.

kz-1yubnnc.p: What is the large belt of icy bodies beyond Neptune's orbit called?
kz-1yubnnc.e: Pluto is the best-known inhabitant. The Oort Cloud lies even further out and is considered the breeding ground of comets.

kz-1nwh7qn.p: Who directed the Soviet science fiction film “Stalker” from 1979?
kz-1nwh7qn.e: The film is based on the novel by the Strugatsky brothers and was shot in an abandoned industrial zone.

kz-tua1vk.p: Who directed “The Seventh Seal”, in which a knight plays chess with Death?
kz-tua1vk.e: The 1957 film was shot in under 40 days, and its image of the chess game is one of the most copied in film history.

kz-1wtprnt.e: The film is set in the 1600s and deals with witch burning. It was made during the occupation and is often read as an allegory.

kz-3foq4r.p: Who composed the oratorio “Messiah”, with its famous Hallelujah chorus?
kz-3foq4r.e: According to tradition, the audience rises when the chorus begins. King George II is said to have done so for the first time in 1743.

kz-fc1wx9.p: Who composed the opera “Saul and David” from 1902?
kz-fc1wx9.e: The same composer later wrote “Maskarade” and six symphonies.

kz-8sbzpy.p: What is the Roman equivalent of Athena?
kz-8sbzpy.e: Juno corresponds to Hera, Venus to Aphrodite and Diana to Artemis.

kz-1xsyqf6.p: What is the name of the ship that, according to myth, is built from the nails of the dead?
kz-1xsyqf6.e: It will carry the giants to Ragnarök. Hringhorni was Baldr's ship and Skidbladnir was Freyr's.

kz-1mg3d32.p: Which grape is used for the Italian wine Barolo?
kz-1mg3d32.e: Nebbiolo grows in Piedmont, and the wines are known for high acidity and strong tannins.

kz-1x9799e.p: What is the Japanese tea ceremony called?
kz-1x9799e.e: The ceremony lasts several hours and is designed for calm and attentiveness.

kz-1951ovs.p: Which Englishman patented a light bulb in 1878, independently of Edison?
kz-1951ovs.e: The two inventors ended up joining forces in the company Ediswan.

kz-hzffgk.p: Which hormone from the pineal gland regulates our body clock?
kz-hzffgk.e: It is released when it gets dark. That is why screen light in the evening can make it harder to fall asleep.

kz-hngpn1.p: In what year was the first volume of The Lord of the Rings published?
kz-hngpn1.e: The Fellowship of the Ring was published in 1954. The Hobbit had already come out in 1937.

kz-mehfet.p: What is the name of the elvish language Tolkien built up, using Finnish as a model?
kz-mehfet.e: Sindarin, by contrast, is built on Welsh. Tolkien was a philologist and began with the languages before he wrote the stories.

kz-g459sn.p: Who plays Gandalf in Peter Jackson's films?
kz-g459sn.e: Christopher Lee plays Saruman and Ian Holm plays the elderly Bilbo.

kz-1ckm5k6.p: What is the name of the sword Bilbo finds in the trolls' cave?
kz-1ckm5k6.e: The sword glows blue when orcs are nearby. Aragorn's sword is called Andúril.

kz-yrgphv.p: Who edited and published The Silmarillion after the author's death?
kz-yrgphv.e: The author's son assembled the book from his father's unpublished manuscripts. It came out in 1977.

kz-11tlvd5.p: Who directed the first Star Wars film, from 1977?
kz-11tlvd5.e: Lucas was allowed to keep the merchandise rights, which made him a billionaire.

kz-5n359l.p: In what year did the first Star Wars film premiere?
kz-5n359l.e: The sequel, The Empire Strikes Back, came out in 1980.

kz-1rinjpo.p: Who provided the voice of Darth Vader in the original trilogy?
kz-1rinjpo.e: David Prowse played the role physically in the costume, while Jones voiced the lines.

kz-12rwp5c.p: In what year was Disney's The Lion King released?
kz-12rwp5c.e: At the time, it was the highest-grossing animated film ever.

kz-1b3zum2.p: What is the name of the sea witch in Disney's The Little Mermaid?
kz-1b3zum2.e: Ursula steals Ariel's voice. In H.C. Andersen's fairy tale, the sea witch has no name.

kz-1hhqety.p: In what year was H.C. Andersen born?
kz-1hhqety.e: He was born in Odense into poor circumstances. His father was a shoemaker.

kz-3jtqpm.p: In what year did H.C. Andersen die?
kz-3jtqpm.e: He died in Copenhagen and is buried at Assistens Cemetery.

kz-uqhptx.p: Which city did H.C. Andersen move to at the age of 14 to become an actor?
kz-uqhptx.e: He came to the capital with little money and a letter of recommendation.

o: A bundle of fresh herbs for soups and stock
A dry spice mix for meat
A French sauce of butter and herbs
A bundle of vegetables for baking
kz-164mw07.e: The bundle is put in the pot and removed before the dish is served.

kz-16n5rph.p: What core temperature must chicken meat reach to be safe to eat?
kz-16n5rph.e: Poultry must be heated through to kill disease-causing bacteria such as salmonella.

kz-9hurbv.p: What type of rice is traditionally used for risotto?
kz-9hurbv.e: The rice releases starch when stirred, which gives the risotto its creamy texture.

kz-1sayr6o.p: Which cheese is used in a classic tiramisu?
kz-1sayr6o.e: The name means 'pick me up' in Italian.

kz-u8xxts.p: What is mayonnaise in chemical terms?
o: An emulsion of oil and water
A solution of salt in oil
A foam of oil and air
kz-u8xxts.e: Lecithin in the egg yolk binds oil and liquid together so the sauce does not separate.

kz-snlwv.e: The journey home from Troy lasted ten years.

kz-1ye0mlc.p: Which god is associated with wine and festivity?

kz-1roi32e.p: Who does Paris choose as the most beautiful in the contest between three goddesses?
kz-1roi32e.e: In return she promised him the most beautiful woman in the world, Helen, and that led to the fall of Troy.

kz-1yapqvb.p: What is the name of the Titan who swallowed his own children out of fear of being overthrown?
kz-1yapqvb.e: Zeus survived because his mother Rhea gave Kronos a stone wrapped in cloth.

kz-12xnoq4.p: Who was flayed alive after losing a musical contest to Apollo?
kz-12xnoq4.e: Marsyas played a flute that Athena had thrown away.

kz-x0hxou.p: Who stars in the series Rita?
kz-x0hxou.e: The series about the free-spirited teacher Rita began in 2012.

kz-5eh0j5.e: Adam Price is also behind Ride Upon the Storm.

kz-18h79ok.p: Who is the lead singer of the band Nephew?
kz-18h79ok.e: Nephew was formed in Copenhagen in the late 1990s.

kz-bj9mns.p: Who is the lead singer of Mew?
kz-bj9mns.e: Mew was formed in 1994 and is especially known for the album Frengers.

kz-1bu351u.p: Who is the singer in the group The Savage Rose?
kz-1bu351u.e: The group was formed in 1967 and blends rock, soul and classical music.

kz-1kjp1cz.p: Who plays Frank in Pusher from 1996?
kz-1kjp1cz.e: Mads Mikkelsen plays Tonny. The film was Nicolas Winding Refn's breakthrough.

kz-1ofdx80.p: Who directed the Oscar-winning film In a Better World from 2010?
kz-1ofdx80.e: The film won both the Oscar and the Golden Globe for best foreign-language film.

kz-1smytj0.p: Which film by Lars von Trier won the Grand Prix at Cannes in 1996?
kz-1smytj0.e: Emily Watson was nominated for an Oscar for the lead role.

kz-wywho4.p: What is the name of Lars von Trier's film company?
kz-wywho4.e: The name comes from his film Europa, which in English was called Zentropa.

kz-1unhsf3.p: What is the name of Denmark's central bank?
kz-1unhsf3.e: It was founded in 1818 and is located on Holmens Kanal in Copenhagen.

kz-l28yx9.p: Who wrote The General Theory of Employment, Interest and Money in 1936?
kz-l28yx9.e: The book argued that the state should get the economy moving in times of recession.

kz-ungtg8.p: What is it called when a central bank buys large quantities of bonds to get money into the economy?
kz-ungtg8.e: The method was used on a large scale after the 2008 financial crisis.

kz-9h9s7.p: What currency did Denmark have before the krone was introduced in 1875?
kz-9h9s7.e: The krone was introduced together with Sweden and Norway in the Scandinavian Monetary Union.

kz-1w6q3h2.p: Which Danish company is behind the headphone brand Jabra?
kz-1w6q3h2.e: GN traces its roots to the Great Northern Telegraph Company, founded in 1869.

kz-fdqa7n.p: Which soft drink was invented by the pharmacist John Pemberton in Atlanta in 1886?
kz-fdqa7n.e: It began as a health tonic and was sold at the pharmacy.

kz-21tp0s.p: Which studio made World of Warcraft?
kz-21tp0s.e: The game came out in 2004 and has had millions of subscribers.

kz-eiy1vw.p: What is the name of the princess Mario tries to rescue in most Mario games?
kz-eiy1vw.e: Zelda belongs to a completely different series.

kz-78lx23.p: Who is the main character in Half-Life?
kz-78lx23.e: Gordon Freeman is a scientist and never says a word in the games.

kz-1bnmwr4.p: Which game series features the level Green Hill Zone?
kz-1bnmwr4.e: The level is the first in the very first Sonic game, from 1991.

kz-qbokqc.p: What does LLM stand for in artificial intelligence?
kz-qbokqc.e: ChatGPT is built on such a language model.

kz-akny30.p: Which app is known for short videos and is owned by the Chinese company ByteDance?

kz-i6u6sl.p: Which big French club did Mikkel Hansen play for from 2012 to 2023?
kz-i6u6sl.e: He then returned home to Aalborg Håndbold.

kz-1kg75vk.p: In which city is Guinness brewed?
kz-1kg75vk.e: The brewery at St. James's Gate has been there since 1759.

kz-1jsw2ur.p: Which spirit is the base of a Moscow Mule?
kz-1jsw2ur.e: The drink is traditionally served in a copper mug with ginger beer and lime.

kz-jf2l32.p: In which French region is the town of Cognac?
kz-jf2l32.e: Only brandy from the area may be called cognac.

kz-9cw8nb.p: Which Danish cheese is named after a farm and was developed by Hanne Nielsen in the 1800s?
kz-9cw8nb.e: Hanne Nielsen experimented with cheese-making on her farm.

kz-gmk5oy.p: What is Greek tzatziki made of?
kz-gmk5oy.e: It is served as a dip or as an accompaniment to grilled meat.

kz-19re4b7.e: The cheese does not melt when fried and is used in dishes such as palak paneer.

kz-n01655.p: Which of these is not a Danish king?
kz-n01655.e: Gustav Vasa was king of Sweden. The other three ruled Denmark.

kz-j9fcxu.p: Which of these is not a composer?

kz-yg8h52.p: Which of these countries is not part of the Nordic region?

kz-qxb6y1.p: Which of these animals is not a predator?
kz-qxb6y1.e: The elk eats leaves, twigs and aquatic plants. The lynx is a wild cat.

kz-ri7i7u.p: Which of these is not a Danish river?

kz-ymexzv.p: Which of these substances is not a vitamin?

kz-54sgx3.p: True or false: Camels store water in their humps.
kz-54sgx3.e: The hump contains fat that the animal can live off for a long time.

kz-1kaonqh.p: True or false: Sharks are mammals.
kz-1kaonqh.e: Sharks are fish and breathe through gills.

kz-wogfjv.p: True or false: Denmark is the smallest EU member state.
kz-wogfjv.e: Malta, Luxembourg and Cyprus are all smaller than Denmark.

kz-o2qxas.p: True or false: Mount Everest is the point on Earth that lies furthest from the Earth's centre.
kz-o2qxas.e: The volcano Chimborazo in Ecuador lies furthest from the centre, because the Earth bulges at the equator.

kz-lsdztr.p: True or false: The Tokyo area has more inhabitants than the whole of Denmark.
kz-lsdztr.e: The metropolitan region has over 35 million inhabitants. Denmark has around six million.

kz-1r00whe.p: In what year was Magna Carta signed?
kz-1r00whe.e: King John of England had to accept that the king too is bound by the law.

kz-5dngsy.p: Which battle in 1066 decided the Norman conquest of England?
kz-5dngsy.e: William the Conqueror defeated the English under King Harold.

kz-11gchj1.p: Who was the UN's first Secretary-General, from 1946?
kz-11gchj1.e: The Norwegian Trygve Lie served until 1952.

kz-r3cgov.p: What is the capital of Suriname?
kz-r3cgov.e: Suriname is South America's smallest independent country and was formerly a Dutch colony.

kz-145zifh.e: The Volga is about 3,500 kilometres long and flows into the Caspian Sea.

kz-1l7r3xw.p: What is the solar system's largest moon?
kz-1l7r3xw.e: Ganymede orbits Jupiter and is larger than the planet Mercury.

kz-eo5dsy.p: Who wrote the novel “Barbara” from 1939 about a woman in 18th-century Tórshavn?
kz-eo5dsy.e: The author died of tuberculosis before the novel was published. William Heinesen is another major Faroese author.

kz-rpdngd.p: Which of these events came first?
kz-rpdngd.e: The printing press came around 1450, Columbus reached America in 1492, Luther posted his theses in 1517, and the revolution came in 1789.

kz-r9mlue.p: Which of these inventions came first?
kz-r9mlue.e: Bell was granted a patent for the telephone in 1876. Edison's light bulb came in 1879, Marconi's radio around 1895, and television in the 1920s.

kz-1uf4mr4.p: Which of these structures was completed first?
kz-1uf4mr4.e: The statue was unveiled in 1886 and the Eiffel Tower was completed in 1889. The Opera House opened in 1973 and the Burj Khalifa in 2010.

kz-tq3opb.p: Which of these services and products came first?
kz-tq3opb.e: Facebook came in 2004, YouTube in 2005 and Twitter in 2006. The first iPhone was unveiled in 2007.

kz-qi5wld.p: What happened or opened first in Denmark?
kz-qi5wld.e: Denmark joined the EC in 1973. The Great Belt Bridge opened in 1998 and the Øresund Bridge in 2000. The euro entered circulation in 2002, but not in Denmark.

kz-d0kotm.p: True or false: Honey can keep for thousands of years.
kz-d0kotm.e: A little water and high acidity mean microbes cannot live in honey.

kz-1xbvpi6.p: True or false: Spiders are insects.
kz-1xbvpi6.e: Spiders have eight legs and belong to the arachnids. Insects have six legs.

kz-k48pqa.p: True or false: The northern lights occur in the Earth's atmosphere.
kz-k48pqa.e: Charged particles from the Sun hit the air at high altitude and make it glow.

kz-12mcus1.p: True or false: Vikings wore horned helmets in battle.
kz-12mcus1.e: The image comes from 19th-century opera and art. No Viking helmets with horns have been found.

kz-1vcnag1.p: True or false: Humans use only ten per cent of their brains.
kz-1vcnag1.e: This is a myth. Scans show that almost all areas of the brain are in use over the course of a day.

kz-pzl0ba.p: True or false: Lightning can strike the same place several times.
kz-pzl0ba.e: Tall buildings such as the Empire State Building are struck many times a year.

kz-19glsbz.p: True or false: Botanically, a tomato is a berry.
kz-19glsbz.e: Botanically, a berry is a fruit with seeds in the flesh. 'Vegetable' is a culinary term.

kz-m887vn.p: True or false: The Great Wall of China can be seen with the naked eye from the Moon.
kz-m887vn.e: It is long but far too narrow. Even from a space station it is hard to spot.

kz-16qy31e.p: What does the Latin phrase 'memento mori' mean?
kz-16qy31e.e: The phrase reminded people of the inevitability of death. 'Carpe diem' is Latin for 'seize the day'.

kz-qcvaqd.p: What is the doctrine called that holds pleasure to be the highest good?
kz-qcvaqd.e: The word comes from the Greek word for joy. The Stoics, by contrast, placed emphasis on peace of mind.

kz-1eftp12.p: Which philosopher is said to have known that he knew nothing?
kz-1eftp12.e: The saying is attributed to Socrates in Plato's writings.

kz-ep2ceb.p: Which way of thinking is about controlling what you can and accepting the rest?
kz-ep2ceb.e: The Stoics believed one should only worry about what one can control.

kz-1tpl9ok.p: Which Frenchman wrote the essay The Myth of Sisyphus on the meaninglessness of life?
kz-1tpl9ok.e: Camus concludes that we must imagine Sisyphus as happy.

kz-13lfn66.p: What is it called when you mostly notice what confirms your own opinion?
kz-13lfn66.e: We unknowingly look for evidence of what we already believe.

kz-1epu29v.p: Who is known for the experiment in which dogs drooled at the sound of a bell?
kz-1epu29v.e: Pavlov discovered classical conditioning while studying the digestion of dogs.

kz-1uliei2.p: What is the fear of enclosed spaces called?
kz-1uliei2.e: Agoraphobia is fear of open squares and large gatherings.

kz-1qnk18i.p: What is it called when people help less the more people are present?
kz-1qnk18i.e: Everyone assumes someone else will take responsibility, so no one does.

kz-1v7qqy6.p: Which half of the brain usually controls language in right-handed people?
kz-1v7qqy6.e: Language is most often located in the left side, but both halves contribute.

kz-1rtsda8.p: What is it called when the first number or impression influences our later judgement?
kz-1rtsda8.e: The first number becomes an anchor point for everything we judge afterwards.

kz-1r8wdf5.p: Which of these is not a Nordic country?
kz-1r8wdf5.e: Estonia is a Baltic country. The Nordic countries are Denmark, Norway, Sweden, Finland and Iceland.

kz-15vfrw6.p: Which of these is not a planet?
kz-15vfrw6.e: Pluto was reclassified as a dwarf planet in 2006.

kz-3yahz7.p: Which of these is not a mammal?
kz-3yahz7.e: Penguins are birds. The others give birth to live young and produce milk.

kz-axl9rw.p: Which of these is not an element?
kz-axl9rw.e: Water consists of two elements, hydrogen and oxygen.

kz-737rqi.p: Which of these is not a programming language?
kz-737rqi.e: Excel is a spreadsheet, but you can program in it.

kz-1kn1s1x.p: Which of these is not a Danish island?

kz-3yd8xf.p: Which home computer from Commodore was released in 1982?
kz-3yd8xf.e: The C64 became one of the best-selling computers ever. The VIC-20 came out in 1981 and the Amiga in 1985.

kz-aeo9zs.p: In what year did Denmark become European football champions?
kz-aeo9zs.e: Denmark came in as a replacement for Yugoslavia and beat Germany in the final.

kz-5xxya2.p: Which film starring Leonardo DiCaprio and Kate Winslet was released in 1997?
kz-5xxya2.e: It won eleven Oscars and earned over a billion dollars.

kz-53pmku.p: Which British pop group sang Wannabe in 1996?
kz-53pmku.e: The song reached number one in a long list of countries.

kz-ataoaj.p: What was the name of the Danish-Norwegian band behind Barbie Girl from 1997?
kz-ataoaj.e: The song sold millions of singles around the world.

kz-h5z4ne.p: Which phone did Steve Jobs present in 2007?
kz-h5z4ne.e: It changed the way mobile phones are used.

kz-13l9tfk.p: In what year did the euro enter circulation?
kz-13l9tfk.e: Coins and notes entered circulation on 1 January 2002. Denmark kept the krone.

kz-101657v.p: Which Pixar film is about a robot who clears up a deserted Earth?
kz-101657v.e: The film came out in 2008 and has almost no dialogue in its first half.

kz-fhsbal.p: In what year was the Brexit referendum held?
kz-fhsbal.e: A majority of just over 51 per cent voted to leave the EU.

kz-qykado.p: Which Nintendo games console was released in 2017?
kz-qykado.e: The console can be connected to a TV or used handheld.

kz-d8bxpa.p: Which series about a chemistry teacher who cooks drugs ended in 2013?
kz-d8bxpa.e: Walter White was played by Bryan Cranston.

kz-kdxt4q.p: Which house has the motto 'Winter is coming' in Game of Thrones?
kz-kdxt4q.e: The motto warns that hard times are on the way.

kz-j97j7h.p: Which animated series has Homer and Marge as the main characters?
kz-j97j7h.e: The series has been running since 1989 and is the longest-running American animated series.

kz-1mmuxzd.p: Which series is set at the Seattle Grace hospital?
kz-1mmuxzd.e: The series has been running since 2005.

kz-9kkhxz.p: Who is the boss in the American version of The Office?
kz-9kkhxz.e: Michael Scott was played by Steve Carell.

kz-1mlirnz.p: Which series follows the friends Ross and Rachel in Manhattan?

kz-djuty5.p: Which wild land mammal is Denmark's largest?
kz-djuty5.e: A red deer stag can weigh up to 200 kilograms.

kz-tvqak3.p: Which bird is Denmark's national bird?
kz-tvqak3.e: The mute swan can be seen in Danish waters and parks all year round.

kz-1rzf33h.p: What is the highest point in Denmark called?
kz-1rzf33h.e: Møllehøj is 170.86 metres. Himmelbjerget is a popular viewpoint, but it is lower.

kz-t5ddj5.p: Which tree is Denmark's national tree?
kz-t5ddj5.e: The beech is a symbol of Danish forests and arrived here after the Ice Age ended.

kz-22g9g5.p: Which symbol does the shipping company Maersk have in its logo?
kz-22g9g5.e: The white star has seven points and sits on a light blue background.

kz-u31sk6.p: Which colour is not used in Google's logo?
kz-u31sk6.e: The logo uses blue, red, yellow and green.

kz-1m7p5ht.p: Which animal features in Ferrari's logo?
kz-1m7p5ht.e: The prancing horse comes from an Italian pilot in the First World War.

kz-1v6wupq.e: IKEA was founded by Ingvar Kamprad in 1943.

kz-1bvt37z.p: What does the name LEGO mean?
kz-1bvt37z.e: The name is formed from the Danish words “leg godt”, meaning “play well”. It is just a coincidence that it also resembles a Latin word.

kz-1kr46hr.e: Yeast eats sugar and produces carbon dioxide, which makes the dough light and airy.

kz-mhvcfi.p: What is used instead of yeast to make cakes rise quickly?
kz-mhvcfi.e: Baking powder releases gas as soon as it becomes wet and warm.

kz-8q0mt1.p: What gives rye bread its sour taste?
kz-8q0mt1.e: The sourdough starter makes lactic acid bacteria work together with the yeast.

kz-e6ide1.p: Which gas contributes most to the man-made greenhouse effect?
kz-e6ide1.e: Methane is more powerful per molecule, but CO₂ is released in far greater amounts.

kz-f3ft3o.p: Which energy source provides the most of Denmark's electricity production?
kz-f3ft3o.e: Wind turbines have supplied over half of Denmark's electricity for several years.

kz-gvozf0.p: Which layer of the atmosphere protects us from UV radiation?
kz-gvozf0.e: The hole over the South Pole was discovered in the 1980s and is slowly closing again.

kz-wwavek.p: Which of these devices was invented first?
kz-wwavek.e: The steam engine came in the 1700s, the bicycle in 1817, the car in 1885 and the first powered aeroplane in 1903.

kz-17wc1is.p: Which of these Danish events happened first?
kz-17wc1is.e: The Battle of Reden was in 1801, the Three Years' War began in 1848, Southern Jutland was reunited with Denmark in 1920, and the occupation came in 1940.

kz-ueil9a.p: Which of these games came out first?
kz-ueil9a.e: Pong came out in 1972, Tetris in 1984, Super Mario Bros. in 1985 and Minecraft in 2009.

kz-1gkr7t8.p: Which of these received the Nobel Prize first?
kz-1gkr7t8.e: Curie received the prize in 1903, Rutherford in 1908, Bohr in 1922 and Fleming in 1945.

kz-xiwezw.p: Which of these was born first?
kz-xiwezw.e: Da Vinci was born in 1452, Michelangelo in 1475, Galileo in February 1564 and Shakespeare in April that same year.

kz-qobbfx.p: True or false: Snow is white because ice crystals scatter light.
kz-qobbfx.e: Each crystal refracts and scatters light in all colours, which is perceived as white.

kz-1ydwxcp.p: True or false: Denmark has never had a queen who ruled in her own right.
kz-1ydwxcp.e: Both Margrete I and Margrethe II ruled in their own right.

kz-1ty4ct5.p: True or false: Every planet in the solar system has at least one moon.
kz-1ty4ct5.e: Mercury and Venus have no moons.

kz-1il2szb.p: True or false: It is impossible to sneeze with your eyes open.
kz-1il2szb.e: That is a myth. You simply blink by reflex, and that can be suppressed.

kz-kg8ivg.p: True or false: Octopuses have blue blood.
kz-kg8ivg.e: The blood contains copper instead of iron, which makes it blue.

kz-1rdjzfx.p: True or false: Water boils at 100 degrees everywhere on Earth.
kz-1rdjzfx.e: The boiling point falls with air pressure, so it is lower in the mountains.

kz-ikn6w9.p: Which Greek philosopher linked happiness to a life of virtue?
kz-ikn6w9.e: Aristotle believed that a good life consists in exercising one's virtues.

kz-15q0xpr.p: What is the idea called that morality does not apply to everyone?
kz-15q0xpr.e: Relativists believe that good and bad actions depend on culture and place.

kz-1b3mbjz.p: What is the theory of beauty and the nature of art called?
kz-1b3mbjz.e: Ethics deals with right and wrong, and logic with correct conclusions.

kz-1txgedh.p: Which Austrian psychiatrist survived Auschwitz and founded logotherapy?
kz-1txgedh.e: Frankl believed that humans are driven above all by the search for meaning.

kz-ec5g37.p: Who is known for the theory of “multiple intelligences”?
kz-ec5g37.e: Gardner proposed several kinds of intelligence, including musical and bodily-kinaesthetic.

kz-1ylfnwl.p: Which psychologist wrote “Thinking, Fast and Slow”?
kz-1ylfnwl.e: Kahneman won the Nobel Prize in Economics for his work on human reasoning errors.

kz-16ubqea.p: What is it called when you credit your own successes and blame failures on bad luck?
kz-16ubqea.e: We often explain our own results more flatteringly than they deserve.

kz-gg29va.p: Who is regarded as the founder of positive psychology?
kz-gg29va.e: Seligman shifted the focus from illness to strengths and wellbeing.

kz-43lrth.p: Who wrote “Ethics” and made a living grinding lenses?
kz-43lrth.e: Spinoza saw God and nature as one and the same.

kz-1r2llbj.e: The book examines what it means to exist.

kz-otiuke.p: Whose thoughts on morality and society are collected in “The Analects”?
kz-otiuke.e: The book is named after his conversations with his students.

kz-dhbnfx.p: What is the Greek colonnade called that gave Stoicism its name?
kz-dhbnfx.e: Zeno taught in the colonnade Stoa Poikile in Athens.

kz-1l0h9ca.e: Facebook bought Instagram in 2012, and the company is now called Meta.

kz-1x9tt9f.p: Which Italian company is behind Nutella?
kz-1x9tt9f.e: Ferrero also makes Kinder Eggs and Ferrero Rocher.

kz-14yrawd.p: Which company launched the Barbie doll in 1959?
kz-14yrawd.e: Mattel is also the company behind Hot Wheels.

kz-3cz49b.p: Which burger chain uses the slogan “I’m lovin’ it”?

kz-4byfpj.p: Which country is Oktoberfest originally from?
kz-4byfpj.e: The festival began in Munich in 1810 as a royal wedding celebration.

kz-dy9rsm.p: Which country does flamenco dance come from?
kz-dy9rsm.e: Flamenco originates from Andalusia in southern Spain.

kz-16u9hh4.p: Which instrument is particularly associated with Scotland?
kz-16u9hh4.e: Bagpipes are played at everything from weddings to military parades.

kz-fd8e4z.p: What is the Muslim month of fasting called?
kz-fd8e4z.e: During Ramadan, many people fast from sunrise to sunset.

kz-1jex2qd.p: What is the traditional Japanese garment called?
kz-1jex2qd.e: The sari is Indian, the hanbok is Korean and the cheongsam is Chinese.

kz-78ib8.p: Who received the patent for the telephone in 1876?
kz-78ib8.e: Bell was, incidentally, born in Scotland and taught deaf people.

kz-xczqv9.p: Who invented the pneumatic bicycle tyre in 1888?
kz-xczqv9.e: Dunlop made the tyre for his son's tricycle.

kz-rj85f9.p: Which machine did James Watt improve so much that it drove industrialisation?
kz-rj85f9.e: Watt's version used far less coal than the older steam engines.

kz-f4ssqa.p: Who developed the method of heat-treating milk that bears his name?
kz-f4ssqa.e: Pasteurisation kills most bacteria without ruining the taste.

kz-dpib49.p: How many eyes does a bee have?
kz-dpib49.e: Two large compound eyes and three small simple eyes on top of the head.

kz-ni9si7.p: How much of an adult's body is water?
kz-ni9si7.e: The share is slightly higher in children and slightly lower in older people.

kz-19vui95.p: Which mammal is the slowest in the world?
kz-19vui95.e: It can take a sloth weeks to digest a single meal.

kz-6qifqp.p: Which land animal has the longest gestation period?
kz-6qifqp.e: An elephant's pregnancy lasts around 22 months.

kz-juu92h.p: Which 1982 film is about a boy and an alien friend?
kz-juu92h.e: The film was directed by Steven Spielberg.

kz-1kczrwj.p: Which band performed “Livin’ on a Prayer” in 1986?
kz-1kczrwj.e: The song became one of the biggest rock hits of the 1980s.

kz-1lotrb6.p: Who became leader of the Soviet Union in 1985 and introduced glasnost?
kz-1lotrb6.e: Glasnost means openness. Gorbachev led the country to its dissolution.

kz-1677bv1.p: Which year did the Nintendo 64 come to Europe?
kz-1677bv1.e: The console came to Japan in 1996 and to Europe in spring 1997.

kz-1m9v0fi.p: Which 1993 film is about recreated dinosaurs?
kz-1m9v0fi.e: The film is based on a novel by Michael Crichton.

kz-45vck9.e: Oasis and Blur were the two great rivals of Britpop.

kz-1nve2l1.p: Which singer broke through in 1998 with “Baby One More Time”?
kz-1nve2l1.e: The song went to number one in many countries.

kz-16klvor.p: Which year did the 11 September terror attacks take place?
kz-16klvor.e: The attacks in New York and Washington changed world politics.

kz-12q6e27.p: Which music player from Apple came out in 2001?
kz-12q6e27.e: The first iPod could hold 1,000 songs.

kz-18klqt2.p: Which country won the football World Cup in 2006?
kz-18klqt2.e: Italy beat France in the final after a penalty shoot-out.

kz-2t0sy6.p: Who was elected President of the United States in 2008?
kz-2t0sy6.e: Obama became the country's first Black president.

kz-huiqr1.p: What are Japan's high-speed trains called?
kz-huiqr1.e: The TGV is French and the ICE is German. The Shinkansen opened in 1964.

kz-16f126e.p: What is a car with both a petrol engine and an electric motor called?
kz-16f126e.e: The Toyota Prius was the first hybrid car in mass production.

kz-1qcim7m.p: Which city opened the world's first underground railway in 1863?
kz-1qcim7m.e: The first line ran with steam locomotives.

kz-19wbugx.p: Which country does the car brand Volvo originally come from?
kz-19wbugx.e: Volvo was founded in Gothenburg in 1927.

kz-8n01ty.p: How many legs does a spider have?
kz-8n01ty.e: Insects have six legs, and spiders have eight.

kz-1ru1kh2.p: What is the world's largest continent?
kz-1ru1kh2.e: Asia is home to about 60 per cent of the world's population.

kz-ipirai.p: Which animal appears alongside the emu on Australia's coat of arms?
kz-ipirai.e: Both animals can only walk forwards, so they were seen as symbols of progress.

kz-nvs2mj.e: The film is regarded as the first summer blockbuster.

kz-b7d4si.p: Which film features the line “I’ll be back”?
kz-b7d4si.e: Arnold Schwarzenegger plays the killer robot.

kz-13mnc5z.p: Which actor won an Oscar for playing the Joker in the 2019 film?
kz-13mnc5z.e: Ledger won posthumously for “The Dark Knight”, but Phoenix won for the film “Joker”.

kz-1pp069u.p: Which Pixar film takes place inside a girl's head?
kz-1pp069u.e: The emotions Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear and Disgust steer the girl Riley.

kz-tk9rdo.p: Which country was excluded from the 1992 European Football Championship, allowing Denmark to take part?
kz-tk9rdo.e: Yugoslavia was excluded because of the war, ten days before the finals began.
